posts.title: From a welfare state to a working state. But what sort of state?
posts.description: Alan Milburn wants to move Britain from a welfare state to a working state. What would it take to build public services that create real opportunities, keep their promises and help young people flourish? From a welfare state to a working state. But what sort of state? - bmwelby's blog - Thoughts from the mind of Ben Welby

posts.title: A little Common Good in the scroll
posts.description: Common Good began with a question about praying for the ordinary work of government. A couple of years and a lot of AI-assisted tinkering later, I'm trying to share 364 days of reflection across social media, and wondering what might happen if more people brought their own experience into the mix. A little Common Good in the scroll - bmwelby's blog - Thoughts from the mind of Ben Welby

posts.title: Imagining a somewhere to be: for people to belong, and to begin
posts.description: Digital government made services easier to use. But what happened as the state disappeared from streets, counters and shared places? Two visits to Glasgow and Grahame Park left me thinking about advisers, regeneration, the affordable mess of civic life, and the places where people might belong and begin.
